faq.question: Which institution is this?
faq.answer: This is Government Thirumagal Mills College in Gudiyatham, affiliated to Thiruvalluvar University. It is separate from Muthurangam Government Arts College in Vellore and similarly named institutions elsewhere.

faq.question: Who can use these entries?
faq.answer: These programmes cover the regular domestic route at a coeducational government college. Meet the exact academic, category and original-document requirements for the selected award.

faq.question: How do shifts and language sections work?
faq.answer: Choose the exact undergraduate degree, shift and language section in the admission process. Confirm the postgraduate timetable and teaching-language arrangement with the department, especially where no language label is shown.

faq.question: What is required for undergraduate entry?
faq.answer: Pass Higher Secondary or a recognised equivalent in all subjects. Mathematics, science and commerce programmes have subject-specific conditions, while arts and language degrees use the applicable government ranking priorities.

faq.question: What are the undergraduate age conditions?
faq.answer: For the 2026 government admission cycle, the UG upper age is 40 as of 1 July 2026. Women and the named categories may receive three years’ relaxation; disability and transgender provisions allow five years, subject to the applicable assessment.

faq.question: What is required for postgraduate entry?
faq.answer: Meet the qualifying degree and subject conditions for the exact award under the applicable university regulations. A recognised degree alone does not establish eligibility for every master’s programme, and selection is not guaranteed.

faq.question: How long are the degrees?
faq.answer: The ordinary undergraduate degrees follow a three-year, six-semester framework. The included nonprofessional postgraduate degrees follow two years and four semesters; professional and research programmes have separate rules.

faq.question: What academic records should I prepare?
faq.answer: Prepare the qualifying marksheets, transfer certificate and relevant category records. Postgraduate applicants also need degree or provisional and semester records; follow the current notice for eligibility acceptance, originals and copies.

faq.question: What fees should I plan for?
faq.answer: Obtain the current amount for the exact degree, shift and applicant category, including tuition and compulsory charges. Keep accommodation, meals, deposits and personal costs separate; no verified current fee amount is displayed here.

faq.question: Does admission include accommodation?
faq.answer: No accommodation entitlement is established by an academic offer. The current government UG directory does not list hostel places for this campus; confirm any available arrangement and its complete charges separately.

faq.question: What academic and welfare support is available?
faq.answer: The college lists library and digital resources, student counselling, grievance, SC/ST welfare and women’s support mechanisms. Confirm the current process and provision for individual learning or accessibility needs.

faq.question: What recognition is verified?
faq.answer: The UGC colleges register records the institution under sections 2(f) and 12B. Current academic affiliation and applicable university rules are separate from the scope of professional programme approval.

faq.question: Can overseas applicants use these domestic entries?
